assessment_en: The complete initial manuscript received an uncalibrated Meritorious candidate opinion, adjacent to HM–Meritorious. The final source diff and PDF pages8–10 and20–26 were checked by the same AI reviewer; the coordinator visually inspected all26 final pages. No fresh full final award assessment was performed, and the older O-center opinion does not apply to this version.
assessment_zh: 初始完整稿获未校准Meritorious候选、相邻HM–Meritorious意见；同一AI评阅者核最终源码差异及PDF第8–10、20–26页，根另实看最终26页。未重新给最终整稿评档，旧O中心意见不适用于本版。
strength_en: Preserves the post-autonomous learning trajectory; suitable for version-comparison context, not a second independent solution.
strength_zh: 保留自主稿之后的学习轨迹，适合展示版本比较而非第二次独立解题。
limits_en: A post-seal same-task learning revision, not a second independent solution. Semantic labels and design effects remain unvalidated; a public code/data reproduction package is not included.
limits_zh: 封存后同题学习修订，不是第二次独立解题；语义标签与设计效果仍未验证，公开案例不含完整代码／数据复现包。
reviewer_identity_zh: 一个作者外AI评阅者完成初始整稿与最终有限增量；根另做成品／源码审阅，非真人同行评审。
reviewer_identity_en: One author-external AI reviewer for the initial complete manuscript and final limited delta; coordinator visual/source review; no human peer reviewer.
identity_zh: 封存后同题学习修订 / post-seal same-task learning revision
review_scope_zh: 初始26页整稿；最终源码差异与10个实际差异页；根另实看最终26页。三种范围分别记录。
review_scope_en: Complete initial26-page manuscript; final source delta and10 final pages; all26 final pages visually checked by the coordinator. These scopes are separate.
